registered_rule: expected_bars(date) = modal bar count across ALL TICKERS that traded that date; a ticker-session is complete iff its observed bar count equals that

source.timezone: bar timestamps converted UTC -> America/New_York before the session date is taken
source.inclusion_predicate: every ticker with at least one 1H bar on that ET session date — no universe, liquidity or family filter, because the rule says ALL TICKERS

grain_assertion.statement: one bar per (ticker, timestamp); the bar count equals the distinct timestamp count for every ticker-session

tie_rule.rule: on a tie for the modal bar count, take the LARGEST tied value
tie_rule.why: a tie must resolve deterministically and must never resolve DOWNWARD — resolving to the smallest tied value is exactly the failure mode that admitted a 2-bar gapped session on 2022-06-10

short_sessions.note: dates whose expected length is below the regular 7 are early closes and stay VALID; the remediation does not reclassify them

not_repaired: anything that is not part of this defect is left exactly as the registered rule computes it — including any date whose market-wide modal is unusual; changing that would be a design review, not a remediation
